Know your units

Decimal prefixes use powers of 1,000: 1 MB equals 1,000,000 bytes. Binary prefixes use powers of 1,024: 1 MiB equals 1,048,576 bytes. One byte contains eight bits.

For example, 1 MB is approximately 0.953674316406 MiB. Storage vendors and operating systems may use different conventions; choose explicit units when comparing capacities.
